headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: By integrating features from projects likeGESTaltX andWireless-Device-Battery-Monitor, ClearInstall can improve its risk assessment capabilities and user interface for a more seamless experience. Additionally, incorporating real-time data from devices could enhance the app's predictive analytics.
actions: Integrate device battery monitoring to alert users of potential issues before installation
Implement real-time risk assessments using machine learning models inspired byGESTaltX’s approach
Enhance user interface with interactive elements and visualizations based onWireless-Device-Battery-Monitor
